findings.issue: All four modules in the notes and syllabus reader accurately reflect the KTU 2024 Group A syllabus.

Notes and syllabus reader comprehensively cover all four modules of GAPHT121. Extracurricular helpers (e.g., capacitor filter, carrier density in doped semiconductors) are clearly marked as 'beyond the syllabus'.

checks.title: Chemistry for Information Science and Electrical Science

findings.issue: Catalog names the course 'Engineering Chemistry' instead of the official title 'Chemistry for Information Science and Electrical Science'.
Syllabus reader omits 'Flow diagram' under Sewage water treatment in Module 4 and 'Number of vibrational modes' under Vibrational spectroscopy in Module 3.

checks.title: Engineering Graphics and Computer Aided Drawing

findings.issue: Module 3 notes include an entire section on 'Reverse Section Problems: Finding the Cutting Plane from a Given True Shape', which the official syllabus explicitly excludes ('Exclude true shape given problems').

Module 4 notes omit the introductory theory on Computer Aided Drawing (CAD) (Introduction, Role of CAD in design and development of new products, Advantages of CAD), although the syllabus notes CAD is for internal evaluation only.

Generated GMEST103 syllabus reader data copies a verbatim typo from the PDF ('In Part A, all questions need to be answered...') into the ESE array, even though GMEST103 has no Part A and consists of 8 questions carrying 15 marks each (4 to be answered).

missing_topics: Module 4: Computer Aided Drawing (CAD) - Introduction, Role of CAD in design and development of new products, Advantages of CAD (internal evaluation only)
extra_or_wrong_topics: Module 3: Reverse Section Problems / True shape given problems (explicitly excluded by syllabus)

checks.title: Introduction to Electrical and Electronics Engineering

findings.issue: Course has 4 official modules, but the repository only has 3 note directories (electrical-module-1 to 3), with Module 4 topics partially merged into the end of electrical-module-3 (pages 9-10) and no electrical-module-4 directory mapped in the catalog.
In Module 1 notes, the energy stored in a capacitor is not explicitly outlined alongside inductor energy storage.
findings.source_evidence: PDF page 27 (GXEST104 Module 1: 'Capacitors & Inductors: V-I relations and Energy stored')

findings.issue: In Module 3 notes, multiple core transistor and amplifier topics are missing from the outline.
In Module 4 (appended to electrical-module-3), the majority of communication systems, block diagrams, and instrumentation topics are missing.

checks.title: Algorithmic Thinking with Python

findings.issue: Module 3 notes completely omit the entire 'RECURSION' unit (Recursion Defined, Reasons for using Recursion, The Call Stack, Recursion and the Stack, Avoiding Circularity in Recursion, and all 5 sample recursive problems) as well as problem decomposition demonstrated using Merge sort.

Module 2 notes omit several required sample problems/flowcharts: evaluating d=a+b*c, printing numbers from 1 to 50 in descending order, largest of n numbers, KTU grade scale using case structure, and sum of n numbers using all three loop variants.
Module 2 notes include misplaced topics from Module 1 (jigsaw puzzle trial and error, restaurant heuristics) and Module 3 (if/elif, range, lists, NumPy arrays).
Module 4 notes omit the Brute-force 'Password guessing' example.

In the syllabus reader (src/features/syllabi/cse.ts), the topic 'Selection, iteration and collections' (if, elif, for, range, while, lists, tuples, sets, strings, dictionaries, NumPy arrays) is placed under Module 2 instead of Module 3.

Module 3: Recursion sample problems - nth Fibonacci number, greatest common divisor of two positive integers, factorial of a positive integer, adding two positive integers, sum of digits of a positive number

catalogue_findings.issue: In CSE S1, GXEST104 lists only 3 modules instead of 4, and GXCYT122 is titled 'Engineering Chemistry' instead of 'Chemistry for Information Science and Electrical Science'. Also, both S1/S2 slot courses (GAPHT121 Physics and GXCYT122 Chemistry) are listed simultaneously in S1.

In ECE and EEE S1 (Group B), the Mathematics course is assigned code 'GYMAT101' (which is not an official KTU 2024 Group B code; Group B Mathematics 1 is GBMAT101), Physics (GBPHT121) has no syllabusHref and GBPHT121 is missing from cseSyllabusModule, GXEST104 only lists 3 modules, and UCEST105 module descriptions in sharedS1Subjects ('Data structures and modular programming', 'Object-oriented and file-based programming', 'Algorithms and data analysis') do not match the KTU 2024 UCEST105 syllabus.

In Civil and Mechanical S1 (Group C), Mathematics (GCMAT101) and Physics (GCPHT121) are completely missing from the catalog; Group A/B courses GMEST103 and GXEST104 are wrongly assigned to Civil/ME instead of Group C's Engineering Mechanics (GCEST103) and Introduction to Mechanical & Civil Engineering (GCEST104); Chemistry (GCCYT122) has no syllabusHref and is missing from cseSyllabusModule; and the modules arrays for Graphics, Electrical, and Python are empty [].
